answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the plume of the next round.
